brief.claim: Across the cell lines, the average expression of the probe sets on the published drug-response signature is higher in the cell lines sensitive to the drug than in the resistant cell lines, by at least 0.5 log2 units (Welch two-sample t test on the per-cell-line signature averages, p < .01).

data_keys.meaning: log2 expression of each microarray probe set in each cell line
True if the probe set is on the published drug-response signature list
True if the cell line is classed as sensitive to the drug, False if resistant
